_readme: Copy to appsettings.Development.json (gitignored) and fill in Jwt:Secret. Defaults below match docker-compose.yml, so `docker compose up -d db mailpit` plus `dotnet run` works unchanged. Docker overrides only ConnectionStrings:Default and Smtp:Host, because inside a container localhost is the container.

Jwt._readme: Generate with `openssl rand -base64 48`. Startup throws below 32 UTF-8 bytes. Never commit a real one.

Smtp._readme: Mailpit, published by docker-compose. Inbox at http://localhost:8025. UseStartTls is false only because local mail catchers offer no TLS at all - deployed environments must leave it true.
